title: 테이블 탐색기
description: DB의 모든 테이블을 자동으로 감지하며 스키마를 미러링하고, 속성(칼럼)별로 개별 그래프 카드를 자동 생성하는 범용 탐색기 대시보드입니다.

list.name: table
list.label: 테이블
list.query: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY (table_name != 'personal_health'), table_name
list.definition: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY (table_name != 'personal_health'), table_name

list.name: property
list.label: 속성 필터
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') AS property FROM (SELECT * FROM ${table:raw} LIMIT 50000) sub WHERE (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') AS property FROM (SELECT * FROM ${table:raw} LIMIT 50000) sub WHERE (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: num_property
list.label: 수치 속성
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') AS property FROM (SELECT * FROM ${table:raw} LIMIT 50000) sub WHERE (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IS NOT NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($property) OR (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IN ($property)) AND (to_jsonb(sub)->>'value') IS NOT NULL AND (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') NOT IN ('sleep_stage') AND lower(coalesce(to_jsonb(sub)->>'value_text', '')) NOT IN ('on', 'off', 'true', 'false', 'online', 'offline') ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') AS property FROM (SELECT * FROM ${table:raw} LIMIT 50000) sub WHERE (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IS NOT NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($property) OR (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IN ($property)) AND (to_jsonb(sub)->>'value') IS NOT NULL AND (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') NOT IN ('sleep_stage') AND lower(coalesce(to_jsonb(sub)->>'value_text', '')) NOT IN ('on', 'off', 'true', 'false', 'online', 'offline') ORDER BY 1

list.name: text_property
list.label: 상태 속성
list.query: SELECT (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') AS property FROM (SELECT * FROM ${table:raw} LIMIT 50000) sub WHERE (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IS NOT NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($property) OR (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IN ($property)) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(to_jsonb(sub)->>'value_text') > 0 AND ((to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IN ('sleep_stage') OR count(to_jsonb(sub)->>'value') = 0 OR bool_and(lower(to_jsonb(sub)->>'value_text') IN ('on', 'off', 'true', 'false', 'online', 'offline'))) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') AS property FROM (SELECT * FROM ${table:raw} LIMIT 50000) sub WHERE (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IS NOT NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($property) OR (to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IN ($property)) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(to_jsonb(sub)->>'value_text') > 0 AND ((to_jsonb(sub)->>'property') IN ('sleep_stage') OR count(to_jsonb(sub)->>'value') = 0 OR bool_and(lower(to_jsonb(sub)->>'value_text') IN ('on', 'off', 'true', 'false', 'online', 'offline'))) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ${table} 컬럼 구성
panels.description: 선택한 테이블의 현재 컬럼 정의와 데이터 타입입니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ordinal_position, column_name, data_type, is_nullable
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = '${table:raw}'
ORDER BY ordinal_position

panels.title: ${table} 청크 구성 (하이퍼테이블인 경우)
panels.description: 선택한 테이블이 하이퍼테이블일 경우의 청크 범위와 압축 상태입니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT chunk_name, range_start, range_end, is_compressed
FROM timescaledb_information.chunks
WHERE hypertable_name = '${table:raw}'
ORDER BY range_start DESC

panels.title: ${table} 최근 데이터 표
panels.description: 선택한 테이블의 모든 컬럼을 스키마 그대로 미러링하여 보여 줍니다. (시간 컬럼 유무 무관 안전 조회)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM ${table:raw} LIMIT 500
) sub
ORDER BY (to_jsonb(sub)->>'time') DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200

panels.title: $num_property
panels.description: 수치형 속성마다 개별 카드(3열 그리드)로 자동 생성됩니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  time,
  value,
  coalesce(nullif(concat_ws(' ', nullif(concat_ws('-', to_jsonb(t)->>'room', to_jsonb(t)->>'device'), ''), unit), ''), property) AS metric
FROM ${table:raw} t
WHERE property = ${num_property:sqlstring}
  AND value IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: $text_property
panels.description: 상태/단계형 속성마다 개별 타임라인 카드(2열 그리드)로 자동 생성됩니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  time,
  value_text AS state,
  coalesce(nullif(concat_ws('-', to_jsonb(t)->>'room', to_jsonb(t)->>'device'), ''), ${text_property:sqlstring}) AS metric
FROM ${table:raw} t
WHERE property = ${text_property:sqlstring}
  AND value_text IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time
